question.text: An object is placed $30 \mathrm{cm}$ away from a convex lens of focal length $10 \mathrm{cm}$ and a sharp image is formed on a screen. Now a concave lens is placed in contact with the convex lens. The screen now has to be moved by $45 \mathrm{cm}$ to get $\underline{a}$ sharp image again.
